The Commission by its order dated 3.10.2006 determined tariff in respect of the generating stations and inter-state transmission systems of the Petitioner, after allowing a special dispensation to the Petitioner to continue with the prevailing tariff till 31.3.2006. Against the Commission’s order dated 3.10.2006, the Petitioner filed Appeal No.273/2006 before the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (in short ‘the APTEL’) on various issues.
